name: vectorer
summary: Framework for embedding-and-vector-based entity resolution: incremental (parse -> embed -> vector-block -> Fellegi-Sunter -> classify) and batch (canopy-block -> Fellegi-Sunter -> Swoosh) pipelines with an extensible comparison set spanning the standard attribute-comparison families of record linkage -- implemented natively in NumPy with no SQL engine.
author: vector-er contributors
